thread:
Alina: heads-up 7 verdant10b bring-up notes. ran int8, int6 (AWQ), and an int4-GPTQ variant across a mixed product slice (short chat, instruction-follow, long-form summarization). posting a compact exec summary + routing suggestion.

Alina: perf (batch=1, seq=1200):
```
int8  tp 11.8 req/s, p50 45ms, p95 170ms, p99 380ms, cost ~$0.030 / 1k tokens
int6  tp 10.2 req/s, p50 52ms, p95 200ms, p99 420ms, cost ~$0.023 / 1k tokens
int4  tp 19.5 req/s, p50 29ms, p95 110ms, p99 260ms, cost ~$0.014 / 1k tokens
fp16  tp 8.0  req/s, p50 72ms, p95 260ms, p99 600ms, cost ~$0.054 / 1k tokens
```

Alina: quality (GTN 9k focused samples):
- fp16 baseline ROUGE-L 0.438
- int8 ROUGE-L 0.433 (-0.5 pts)
- int6 ROUGE-L 0.424 (-1.4 pts)
- int4 ROUGE-L 0.401 (-3.7 pts)

Marcus: quick unit-econ: assume 1.7k tokens/req -> int8 ~$0.051/req, int6 ~$0.039/req, int4 ~$0.024/req. Moving 40% traffic to int6 saves ~ $5.0k per 100k requests vs fp16.

Devon: ops saw intermittent token misalignment on int4 for >2k contexts (edge case). filed ML-1309. recommend gating int4 to short-singleton routes. Also noticed higher p99 drift for int6 under burst: will add retry/fallback counters.

Priya: product: how visible are the quality changes?

Alina: short completions and single-turn instruction prompts: negligible delta. Long summaries (multi-doc merge) and step-by-step reasoning: most of the gap.

Marcus: proposed routing (start conservative):
```json
{"model":"verdant10b","routes":{
  "short-complete":{"int6":0.7,"int8":0.3},
  "long-summary":{"int8":1.0},
  "background-batch":{"int4":0.9,"int6":0.1}
},"fallback":"int8","canary_samples":5000}
```

Priya: GTN gating (24h smoke): ROUGE-L drop <=1.0 absolute on summary slice, p99 latency increase <=25%, client error rate <=0.25%. Any failure for summary route -> rollback.

Alina: mitigation path:
- mixed-precision decode (prefix int6, decode int8) recovered ~0.6 ROUGE points in bench.
- short quant-finetune (3k steps) predicted to recover ~0.9-1.2 pts for int6; estimate ~3 TPU-days.

Devon: ops checklist pre-canary: KV-cache alignment patch (PR#601), increase canary quota, 6h shadow run, add monitor for token-corruption and fallback counts. Tentative canary slot: 2025-06-09T02:00Z.

Marcus: decision recs for GTN docs:
- immediate: enable int6 for short-complete routes at low weight; keep int8/pinned for long-summary.
- short-term: run 50k focused-sample eval on product signals to map regression slices. Marcus to own.
- medium-term: run quant-finetune + mixed-decode path and re-evaluate.

Priya: I'll draft the GTN acceptance doc and consumer-facing FAQ blurb about cost tiers.

release-bot: Canary scheduled: verdant10b-int6 -> 2025-06-09T02:00Z, samples=5000, owner=Devon. Monitoring: latency, rouge-l, errors, fallback-counts.

Devon: will post shadow + canary readout here. tagging @Alina @Marcus @Priya. summary stance: int6 looks like the pragmatic cost/quality sweet spot for short flows; int4 only for gated cheap-batch with strong postfilters and further calibration. :white_check_mark:
